messages.subject: For Lisa Su | AI compute, government relations and global stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear AMD Communications Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Dr. Lisa Su, Chair and Chief Executive Officer.

AMD's growth across AI compute, data centers and advanced semiconductors increasingly intersects with governments, infrastructure investment, strategic technology policy and global partners. That environment aligns closely with my current leadership responsibilities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, global-affairs strategy and stakeholder execution might support AMD's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to AMD.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
